ei.subject: 수능특강 영어
ei.title: Elephants as Keystone Species in Savannas

fullPassage:
One example of human interventions modifying the character of savannas is through their effects on savanna-dwelling mammals such as elephants. They are what is known as a 'keystone species' because they have a strong effect on many aspects of the environment in which they live. They diversify the ecosystems which they occupy and create a mosaic of habitats by browsing, trampling, and knocking over bushes and trees. They also spread seeds through their eating and defecating habits and maintain or create water holes by wallowing. All these roles are beneficial to other species. Equally, if humans reduce elephant numbers in a particular piece of savanna, the savanna may become less diverse and less open, and its water holes may fill with mud. This will be harmful to other species.

[삽입 문장] Conversely, where human interference prevents elephants from moving freely within their habitats and leads to their numbers exceeding the carrying capacity of the savanna, their effect can be environmentally disastrous.

questions.passage: One example of human interventions (A)[modifying / preserving] the character of savannas is through their effects on savanna-dwelling mammals such as elephants. They are what is known as a '(B)[keystone / minor] species' because they have a strong effect on many aspects of the environment in which they live. They (C)[diversify / simplify] the ecosystems which they occupy.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅③ modifying — keystone — diversify = 원문과 일치
❌① minor: keystone의 반대
❌② preserving: modifying과 다름
❌④ simplify: diversify의 반의어

questions.passage: They also spread seeds through their eating and (A)[defecating / digesting] habits and (B)[maintain / destroy] or create water holes by wallowing. All these roles are (C)[beneficial / harmful] to other species.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅② defecating — maintain — beneficial = 원문과 일치
❌① destroy: maintain의 반의어
❌③ digesting: defecating과 다름
❌④ harmful: beneficial의 반의어

questions.passage: Equally, if humans (A)[reduce / increase] elephant numbers in a particular piece of savanna, the savanna may become less (B)[diverse / uniform] and less open, and its water holes may fill with (C)[mud / water]. This will be harmful to other species.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅① reduce — diverse — mud = 원문과 일치
❌② increase: reduce와 반대
❌③ uniform: diverse의 반의어
❌④ water: mud와 다름
det.tip: 코끼리 감소 → 다양성↓, 개방성↓, 물웅덩이 진흙으로 채워짐

questions.passage: One example of human interventions modifying the character of savannas is through their effects on savanna-dwelling mammals such as elephants. They are what is known as a 'keystone species' because they have a strong effect on many aspects of the environment. They ①<u>diversify</u> the ecosystems which they occupy and create a ②<u>mosaic</u> of habitats by browsing, trampling, and knocking over bushes and trees. They also spread seeds through their eating and defecating habits. All these roles are ③<u>harmful</u> to other species. Equally, if humans reduce elephant numbers, the savanna may become less ④<u>diverse</u>.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중에서 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 코끼리의 역할은 다른 종에게 유익하다(beneficial). harmful(해로운)은 반대.
det.analysis:
❌③ harmful(해로운) → beneficial(유익한)
✅① diversify: 원문 일치
✅② mosaic: 원문 일치
✅④ diverse: 원문 일치

questions.passage: One example of human interventions modifying the character of savannas is through their effects on savanna-dwelling mammals such as elephants. They diversify the ecosystems which they occupy and create a mosaic of habitats by browsing, trampling, and knocking over bushes and trees. They also spread seeds through their eating and defecating habits and ①<u>maintain</u> or create water holes by ②<u>wallowing</u>. All these roles are ③<u>beneficial</u> to other species. Equally, if humans reduce elephant numbers, the savanna may become ④<u>more</u> diverse.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중에서 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 코끼리가 줄면 사바나는 덜(less) 다양해진다. more(더)는 반대.
det.analysis:
❌④ more(더) → less(덜): 코끼리 감소 → 다양성 감소
✅① maintain: 원문 일치
✅② wallowing: 원문 일치
✅③ beneficial: 원문 일치
det.tip: less diverse(덜 다양한) ↔ more diverse(더 다양한)

questions.passage: Conversely, where human ①<u>interference</u> prevents elephants from moving freely within their habitats and leads to their numbers ②<u>exceeding</u> the carrying capacity of the savanna, their effect can be environmentally ③<u>beneficial</u>. This will be ④<u>harmful</u> to other species.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중에서 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌③ beneficial(유익한) → disastrous(재앙적인)
✅① interference: 원문 일치
✅② exceeding: 원문 일치
✅④ harmful: 원문 일치

det.analysis:
✅② keystone: 원문과 일치
❌① endangered: 멸종위기

det.tip: keystone species = 핵심종 (생태계에 큰 영향을 미치는 종)

questions.passage: One example of human interventions modifying the character of savannas is through their effects on savanna-dwelling mammals such as elephants. questions.stem: 윗글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅④ mosaic: 원문과 일치 (다양한 서식지 패턴)
❌① destruction: 파괴
❌② barrier: 장벽
❌③ shortage: 부족
det.tip: mosaic of habitats = 다양한 서식지가 모자이크처럼 존재

questions.passage: They diversify the ecosystems which they occupy and create a mosaic of habitats by browsing, trampling, and knocking over bushes and trees. questions.stem: 윗글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 코끼리 수가 사바나의 수용력(carrying capacity)을 초과하면 환경적으로 재앙적.
det.analysis:
✅① carrying capacity: 원문과 일치
❌② biodiversity: 생물다양성
❌③ temperature: 온도
❌④ landscape: 경관
det.tip: carrying capacity = 수용력 (생태계가 지탱할 수 있는 최대 개체 수)

questions.passage: They <u>diversify</u> the ecosystems which they occupy and create a mosaic of habitats by browsing, trampling, and knocking over bushes and trees.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 diversify와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.analysis:
✅③ vary: diversify의 동의어
❌① simplify: 단순화하다 (반의어)
❌② reduce: 줄이다
❌④ eliminate: 제거하다

questions.passage: All these roles are <u>beneficial</u> to other species. Equally, if humans reduce elephant numbers, the savanna may become less diverse.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 beneficial과 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.analysis:
✅② advantageous: beneficial의 동의어
❌① detrimental: 해로운 (반의어)
❌③ negligible: 무시할 수 있는
❌④ indifferent: 무관심한

questions.passage: Conversely, where human <u>interference</u> prevents elephants from moving freely within their habitats and leads to their numbers exceeding the carrying capacity of the savanna, their effect can be environmentally disastrous.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 interference와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.analysis:
✅① intervention: interference의 동의어
❌② assistance: 도움 (반대)
❌③ protection: 보호
❌④ cooperation: 협력

questions.passage: Conversely, where human interference prevents elephants from moving freely within their habitats, their effect can be environmentally <u>disastrous</u>.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 disastrous와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.analysis:
✅④ beneficial: disastrous의 반의어
❌① catastrophic: 재앙적인 (동의어)
❌② devastating: 파괴적인 (동의어)
❌③ ruinous: 파멸적인 (동의어)

questions.passage: One example of human interventions <u>modifying</u> the character of savannas is through their effects on savanna-dwelling mammals.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 modifying과 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.analysis:
✅③ preserving: modifying의 반의어
❌① changing: 변경 (동의어)
❌② altering: 변형 (동의어)
❌④ adjusting: 조정 (동의어)

questions.passage:
(A) They are what is known as a 'keystone species' because they have a strong effect on many aspects of the environment in which they live.

(B) The new policy will take effect from next month and change how businesses operate.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 effect가 각 문맥에서 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A) effect = 영향 (have an effect on = ~에 영향을 미치다), (B) effect = 효력 (take effect = 효력을 발휘하다)
det.analysis:
✅② (A) 영향 — (B) 효력
❌① 결과가 아니라 영향
❌③ 의미가 뒤바뀜
❌④ 결과가 아님
det.tip: have an effect on = ~에 영향을 미치다, take effect = 효력을 발생하다

questions.passage: One example of human interventions modifying the character of savannas is through their effects on savanna-dwelling mammals. They __________ (diverse) the ecosystems which they occupy.
questions.stem: 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오.

det.analysis: 주어(They) + 동사 필요 → diversify (동사형)

questions.passage: They diversify the ecosystems which they occupy and create a mosaic of habitats by browsing, trampling, and knocking over bushes and trees. questions.stem: 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오.

det.analysis: environmentally disastrous: 부사 + 형용사

questions.passage: They are what is known as a 'keystone species' because they have a strong effect on many aspects of the environment in which they live. det.korean: 코끼리가 줄면 사바나는 덜 다양하고 덜 개방적이 된다.

det.korean: 수용력 초과 시 환경적으로 재앙적이 될 수 있다.
